report.clinical_summary: The patient has been on Triumeq (abacavir/dolutegravir/lamivudine) for three years but reports inconsistent adherence, including missed doses and drug holidays, primarily due to side effects and questioning whether the effort is worth it. They are experiencing increased fatigue, occasional headaches, and mood swings (anxiety, sadness). HIV significantly disrupts work, relationships, and leisure, and they struggle with internalized stigma and isolation. They have a supportive network and use self-care strategies, and they accept HIV as a lifelong condition while trying not to let it define them.
